title: Complete first reproducible L1 map salvage sample
goal: Take one stable runtime map scene through capture, tilemap identification, derived structural reconstruction and committed evidence so the same pipeline can be reused for villages, world map and dungeon floors.
definition_of_done: A stable non-menu map scene is captured with the deterministic remote lab.
The resident map/tilemap page or equivalent BG structure is identified with reproducible evidence.
Derived tilemap/metatile metadata is generated by committed tools.
A derived evidence summary for the sample is committed under data/maps or docs/analysis.
The next step toward ROM-side loader/DMA/source-format recovery is recorded without requiring chat history.

done.item: Map/world reconstruction workstream and completion levels L0..L5 defined.
Deterministic remote lab pauses between commands and advances only explicitly requested frames.
Remote-lab launcher supports unthrottled maximum-speed execution while preserving exact frame counts; normal speed remains available explicitly.
Runtime map capture command implemented for VRAM/CGRAM/OAM/screenshot/manifest where the active core exposes the relevant domains.
PPU-independent VRAM tilemap-page ranker implemented with fill/high-priority false-positive penalties.
VRAM plus screenshot BG-parameter inference prototype implemented; current correlations are candidate evidence only.
PPU/CGRAM mirroring path was corrected to follow the proven BizHawk onmemorywrite call convention, but the active Snes9x core still needs a fresh stable-map validation capture.

observed_not_yet_promoted.observation: Interior runtime capture structurally favored VRAM page 0x1000 as main-map candidate; 0x1800 is a possible secondary/simple BG.
observed_not_yet_promoted.reason_not_promoted: Needs stable-scene repeat and/or loader/DMA/PPU corroboration.

observed_not_yet_promoted.observation: Field-transition runtime capture showed VRAM page 0xA000 with map-like structure; 0xF800 behaved like fill/UI/overlay.
observed_not_yet_promoted.reason_not_promoted: Capture occurred around transition state and needs stable-map repeat.

observed_not_yet_promoted.observation: Initial BG bpp/character-base brute force did not visually reproduce the room well enough to promote a render parameter set.
observed_not_yet_promoted.reason_not_promoted: Keep structural page evidence separate from weak render-parameter correlation.

in_progress: Obtain a fresh stable map capture after the corrected PPU/CGRAM hook code is active.
Promote one map sample from candidate page ranking to committed L1 structural evidence.
Determine whether the active core can provide enough register/DMA evidence to identify BG assignment directly; otherwise continue with VRAM-delta/loader tracing.

next_actions.action: Verify latest main HEAD and preserve any parallel commits before changing shared files.
Launch remote lab in default max-speed mode and resume to a stable non-menu map scene.
Capture the stable scene with map-capture, keeping raw VRAM/CGRAM/OAM outside Git.
Run rank_vram_tilemap_pages.py and compare the candidate page against the prior interior/field observations.
If PPU mirror values are valid, run reconstruct_map_capture.py; otherwise use repeat captures and VRAM deltas to establish the active tilemap page without guessing BG parameters.
Commit a derived sample evidence summary and update this checkpoint before continuing to map loader/DMA tracing.

do_not_redo: Do not redesign the pause/exact-frame remote-lab model; it already solved uncontrolled frame advance.
Do not treat a screenshot as a complete map.
Do not commit raw ROM, savestate, SRAM, VRAM, CGRAM or OAM dumps.
Do not promote bpp/character-base settings from the current weak screenshot-correlation experiment.
Do not treat constant/high-priority VRAM pages as map pages merely because repetition scores are high.
Do not force older handoffs over newer main commits.

runtime_only_artifacts.description: Interior capture used for initial VRAM-page ranking; raw runtime data, not Git content.

chat_policy.resume_behavior: Read this file, verify latest main, then continue from next_actions[0] without redoing done/do_not_redo items.
